messages:
Claire: Quick announcement: pilot for delegated experiment budgets is starting next month. Short version below, full doc linked. :rocket:

Claire: Goals: let product teams run small vendor experiments faster, reduce PO back-and-forth for low-risk buys, keep audit trail. Pilot window: May 1 - Aug 31.

Claire: Rules (TL;DR): 1) Per-experiment cap $4,000. 2) Team lead must pre-approve in Concur + enter project tag. 3) Vendor onboarding still required for new suppliers (short form allowed for low-risk SaaS).

DevTeamLead: Clarify 1 what counts as "experiment" vs normal project spend?

Claire: Experiment = clearly time-boxed effort <90 days with defined success metrics. If it's an ongoing recurring subscription, treat as normal procurement.

Rakesh: Who audits experiments? Any change to finance ops review frequency?

Claire: FinanceOps will run weekly samples and a monthly audit. Projects selected for audit will need a 1-paragraph result summary and receipts. We'll publish the sample checklist.

ProcurementBot: Automated note: delegated experiment spend flagged when project tag includes `EXP-DELEGATE`. Ensure vendor form is attached for any new vendor. (logged at 1801002085)

DevTeamLead: If an experiment hits $4k mid-run, can we request an exception?

Claire: Yes  exceptions via `EXC-EXP` flow. Director signoff required for exceptions up to $20k; >$20k goes to FP&A. Expect 48-72 hour turnaround for exception reviews.

PeopleOps: Heads up  will this change onboarding docs so new PMs know the experiment path?

Claire: Yes, I'll send a one-pager for onboarding + a 3-step cheat sheet for managers.

Rakesh: Any SLA changes for vendor review during the pilot?

Claire: Standard SLA stays 5 business days, but low-risk SaaS marked `EXP-DELEGATE` will be on an expedited mini-lane target of 48 hours. Security/infrastructure vendors excluded.

DevTeamLead: How are we tracking experiment budgets? Is there a central ledger?

Claire: We'll create a dashboard in the finance portal with live spend by project tag. Teams must reconcile expenses weekly.

ProcurementBot: Reminder: vendor forms missing tax docs will be auto-pended after 72 hours. (automated at 1801002120)

Rakesh: One more  what about corporate card usage for experiments? Cardholders still need to follow recon rules?

Claire: Yes  corporate card policies unchanged. Card use ok within the $4k cap, but receipts and project tag required within 5 business days. Noncompliance may trigger card suspension.

DevTeamLead: Sounds good. Can we opt into the pilot per-team or is it opt-out?

Claire: Opt-in. Apply via the procurement portal before April 24. Link: <https://redwood.internal/finance/exp-pilot|experiment pilot page>.

PeopleOps: I'll add the blurb to the manager weekly and the new-hire packet.

Claire: Thanks everyone. Ping me or @Procurement for edge cases. :slightly_smiling_face:
